title: Welcome to the Comic-verse
description: Welcome to `code-comic`, where we take the drudgery out of understanding codebases by transforming them into visually engaging narratives.
panel_text: A new hire looks perplexed at a screen displaying a comic strip instead of code, labeled 'code-comic'.
speech_bubble: Forget boring `README.md` files; we turn your GitHub repository architecture into a 4-scene comic explanation!
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    Repo[Repository]
    _code_comic_ignore[".code-comic-ignore"]
    _env_example[".env.example"]
    LICENSE["LICENSE"]
    README_md["README.md"]
    Repo --> _code_comic_ignore
    Repo --> _env_example
    Repo --> LICENSE
    Repo --> README_md

title: The Grand Inauguration
description: It all kicks off with a simple command, but behind the scenes, we're gobbling up configuration from `.env.example` and prepping for AI magic.
panel_text: A developer types a command into a terminal, while a `.env` file icon glows faintly next to a 'Gemini API key' label.
speech_bubble: After you `uv sync` and set up your `.env` with a Gemini API key, just run `cli.py`.

title: Brainwaves & Brushes
description: The real secret sauce is how `analyze_repo` dissects your codebase, then `ComicRenderer.render` brings your architecture to life, often guided by insights from `docs/COPILOT_USAGE.md`.
panel_text: A flow chart shows 'analyze_repository' leading to 'ComicRenderer.render', with thought bubbles pointing to 'GitHub Copilot Chat'.
speech_bubble: Our `analyze_repository` function feeds `ComicRenderer.render` – it’s like magic, thanks to GitHub Copilot Chat!

title: Your Next Masterpiece
description: You'll be generating beautiful output like `output-20260613-155630` in no time, and maybe even sketching out the future with `docs/FOUNDRY_IQ.md`.
panel_text: A smiling new hire holds a comic book with the `code-comic` logo, looking toward a whiteboard with 'Future Features' written on it.
speech_bubble: Now you know how `code-comic` works. Ready to tackle `docs/FOUNDRY_IQ.md` or enhance the comic output?
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    Dev["Developer"] --> Read["Read docs"]
    Read --> Code["Write example, html, json, lock, md, mmd, png, py, toml, txt code"]
    Code --> Ship["Ship changes"]
